svg.text: model.py _time_encoding() · a learned Fourier code of time-to-anchor, added to every per-second token
1. The quantity — Δ, position in the window
Δₙ = (T − 1 − n) / T n = 0 … T−1, T = observation_time = 30
Relative, not absolute: invariant to where the window sits in the recording,
and recency is the quantity that should matter.
Δ = 0 is the last observed second, which still sits anticipation_time before the anchor:
Δ measures position in the window, not distance to the anchor.
Why the slot index is enough: the loader end-aligns all three per-second modalities
location / gaze — filled from slot T−1 downwards, gaps left as padding.
video — padded at the FRONT, features packed contiguously; equivalent only because
EgoVLPv2 is dense at 1 Hz (0 of 3,516 P08 frame gaps ≠ +1 s). forward() asserts T == 30.
time_W_r — nn.Parameter(384, 1), 384 parameters, the only learned
part. init N(0, time_encoding_scale²), default scale 10.
Fourier, not nn.Embedding(30, 768): Δ=3 s and Δ=4 s stay near each other.
same Δ on all three axis streams
a fused box is an aggregate — no timestamp
one token per voxel, not per second
Padding slots receive te like any other token, and are masked out of attention anyway.
This is what breaks temporal permutation invariance on purpose: after it, reversing the
30 seconds must change the logits, while permuting OBB tokens still must not.
4. What one second’s code looks like
the 30 codes at scale 10, one row per second; 64 of the 384 cos channels, sorted by |w|
learned frequency |w| — one channel = one sinusoid in Δ
Left columns vary smoothly down the 30 rows — those channels are what carries recency.
Right columns already flip sign between adjacent seconds: that is aliasing, and a larger
time_encoding_scale does it to every channel at once.
cosine similarity between the code at Δ=0 and the code k seconds earlier
k = seconds between the two tokens
W_r ~ N(0, s²) makes the code an RBF kernel in Δ, so the
scale is a length-scale in seconds: √2·T / s
closest pair = min pairwise distance over the 30 unit-norm codes, mean of 20 inits. Ablate {2, 10, 30}.
cos² + sin² = 1, so W_r sets frequencies and can
At gain fixed the code is 0.707 — 2.6% of a location
token, 12% of a visual one. Measured on a trained te10
checkpoint, time_W_r moved 0.025% from its init over
19k steps: a term that small cannot earn a gradient.
gain learned unit-norms the code and scales it by a
trainable scalar, so the model picks how loud recency is.
